heading: **3 April 2026**
body:
*Clean-up NCFS/HTFS samples*

NCFS N40:

- 1% SDS was added to the total sample and then split into 24 tubes → concentrated in SpeedVac for \~30 mins  
- Then I added 0.2 mg/mL Proteinase K and placed the sample at 37 C, 60 mins

NCFS 147:

- 0.5% SDS was added to the total sample  
- Added 0.2 mg/mL Proteinase K and placed the sample at 37 C, 60 mins

3 M Sodium Acetate

- Add 1.1 mL sodium acetate to NCFS N40  
- Add 1.2 mL sodium acetate to NCFS 147

Isopropanol

- Add 12.5 mL isopropanol to NCFS N40  
- Add 13.5 mL isopropanol to NCFS 147

*MNase test for new nucleosome samples* 

5-10 ng of sample \+ 5 uL MNase buffer \+ 1 uL dMNase \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin (total 50 uL)

Treat at 37 C, 15 mins.

Run on a 1% agarose gel and stain with SYBR Green. 

Samples:

1. ELF2lig1  
2. ELF2shHindIII  
3. ELF2shEcoRV  
4. lig50k  
5. ELF2lig1-nuc  
6. ELF2shHindIII-nuc  
7. ELF2shEcoRV-nuc  
8. lig50k-nuc
title: Clean-up NCFS/HTFS samples
